notes: §2002:14.8.1.3 GR8: DATE YYYYMMDD is an 8-digit unsigned display integer; the golden checks NUMERIC, MM 01-12, DD 01-31, equality with CURRENT-DATE (1:8) (§2002:15.16.2 RV1) and '00'+YYYYMMDD in 9(10). It also checks YYYYMMDD then 2 spaces in X(10), which pins the 8-digit width. Matched at --std 2002.
